# Composition

## Rules

- `CodeGraphProvider`: lifecycle-managed facade. `index(options)` with `force: true` clears logical contents and reprocesses every selected input; MUST NOT physically recreate storage. `clear()` removes logical contents from open reusable store. `recreate()` physically recovers storage only while closed; open call rejects typed closed-provider precondition; success leaves provider closed. `open()` parameterless; reports typed recoverable corruption/schema error; never recreates implicitly. `close()` idempotent, including future async-dispose; settles or rejects outstanding requests before worker and database shutdown. Public callers MUST NOT use recreation as ordinary indexing maintenance; SDK forced reindex orchestration is supported recovery path. Worker protocol and lock-helper methods internal.
- Queries (`getSymbol`, `findSymbols`, `getFile`, `getDocument`, config-relative file/document lookups, spec/coverage, statistics), exact batches, full-text search, traversal, impact, selector normalization delegate to store/services. `getSpec` returns `undefined` when absent. Each composite operation performs exactly one availability/staleness validation before bounded fan-out.
- Impact: symbol, file, multi-file, spec, and public-binding operations accept shared typed impact filter; delegate complete request through lifecycle and single availability-validation boundary; return already-filtered deterministic `ImpactResult`. `ImpactResult.affectedSpecs` for every target family. Symbol and public-binding ops requesting `specs` return coverage-derived specs, not empty target-specific projection. Composition passes filter predicates to traversal and active `GraphStore`; MUST NOT filter by projecting unrestricted result after traversal. SQLite path preserves request through store and worker so physical queries receive normalized predicates. Export host-facing impact filter, result-type, and request types. Query plans, SQLite predicate builders, worker request DTOs, backend candidate types internal.
- Factory overloads: `createCodeGraphProvider(config: SpecdConfig, options?: CodeGraphCompositionOptions)` derives storage root from `config.configPath`; `createCodeGraphProvider(options: CodeGraphOptions)` requires `storagePath`. Detect overload via project-root-bearing `SpecdConfig`. Both select `options.graphStoreId ?? "sqlite"`, merge built-in `sqlite` plus additive `graphStoreFactories`, reject `sqlite` collision (MUST NOT replace built-in), unknown id throws registry unknown-backend error, create one `GraphStore`, register TypeScript/Python/Go/PHP plus additive `adapters`, wire `IndexCodeGraph`. `CodeGraphCompositionOptions` matches `CodeGraphOptions` additive model. `Readonly<Record<string, GraphStoreFactory>>` at most one external factory per id. External factories obey same lifecycle and storage-root contract.
- `createSqliteGraphStoreFactory()` accepts `SqliteGraphStoreFactoryOptions`, including optional serializable `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`. Factory/provider creation synchronous. Native loading, worker startup, schema preparation, runtime binding resolution, generation checks during `open()`. Absolute `modulePath` converted to `file:` URLs before dynamic import.
- `CodeGraphProvider` type-only. Concrete class, constructor, `GraphStore`, worker protocol, `IndexCodeGraph` inputs internal. Callers only via `createCodeGraphProvider(...)`.
- Public `.` exports: `createCodeGraphProvider`, type-only `CodeGraphProvider`, `CodeGraphCompositionOptions`, `CodeGraphOptions`, `GraphStoreFactory`, `GraphStoreFactoryOptions`, `SqliteGraphStoreFactoryOptions`, `createSqliteGraphStoreFactory`, `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`, `SQLiteGraphStoreOptions`; `runIsolatedGraphIndex` plus host input/progress/result/typed worker failure contracts; `GetGraphHealth`, `GetGraphHealthInput`, `GetGraphHealthResult`, `createGetGraphHealth`, `IndexProjectGraph`, `IndexProjectGraphInput`, `createIndexProjectGraph`, `GetSpecCoverage`, `GetSpecCoverageInput`, `GetSpecCoverageResult`, `createGetSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverageInput`, `GetChangeSpecCoverageResult`, `createGetChangeSpecCoverage`; `buildProjectGraphConfig`, `createBootstrapGraphConfig`, `GraphConfigOverrides`; `IndexOptions`, `IndexProgressCallback`, `ProjectGraphConfig`, `WorkspaceIndexTarget`, `DiscoveredSpec`, `IndexResult`, `IndexError`, `WorkspaceIndexBreakdown`, `DiscoverFilesOptions`, `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATHS`; `TraversalOptions`, `TraversalResult`, `ImpactResult`, `FileImpactResult`, `ChangeDetectionResult`, `RiskLevel`, `analyzeFilesImpact`; `DEFAULT_HOTSPOT_KINDS`, `HotspotEntry`, `HotspotOptions`, `HotspotResult`; `SearchOptions`, `expandSymbolName`, `expandSearchQuery`, `expandSearchToken`; `isGraphStale`, `computeGraphFingerprint`, `computeRootFingerprint`, `computeWorkspaceFingerprint`, `parseFingerprintMap`, `serializeFingerprintMap`, `detectFingerprintMismatch`, `GraphFingerprintInput`; `LanguageAdapter`; `FileNode`, `DocumentNode`, `SymbolNode`, `SpecNode`, `Relation`, `SymbolKind`, `RelationType`, `SymbolQuery`, `GraphStatistics`, `ImportDeclaration`, `ImportDeclarationKind`, `SourceLocation`, `BindingScopeKind`, `BindingSourceKind`, `BindingScope`, `BindingFact`, `CallForm`, `CallFact`, `ResolvedDependency`; resolver input/result/status/reason/provenance types and factories, logical-symbol/public-binding/member/coverage vocabulary, enriched health/index result types, unified search input/result and source-match value objects; `SpecdCodeGraphError` and subclasses `StoreNotOpenError`, `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `SpecNotFoundError`, `GraphProviderStaleError`, `StoreOverloadError`, `StoreWorkerError`, `BulkSessionStateError`, `InvalidGraphStoreConfigurationError`, `GraphSchemaIncompatibleError`, `GraphStorageRecoveryRequiredError`, `GraphStoreRecreateRequiresClosedError`, graph busy error from isolated execution, isolated-worker failure subclasses; `CODE_GRAPH_VERSION`. No raw locks, IPC envelopes, child bootstrap, launchers, executable child, concrete stores, test-only worker helpers, unrestricted star exports. Removed Ladybug symbols MUST NOT return. Host-facing isolated-worker contracts stay public (not raw IPC DTOs).
- `src/public.ts` is `.`; `src/index.ts` is `./internal` (indexer internals, store adapters, raw locks, launchers, `InMemoryIndexSession`). Published package includes built ESM isolated-worker child under `dist/`, resolved by `runIsolatedGraphIndex` from installed module location, not a host-selectable export. `package.json` maps both entrypoints.
- Hosts call `open()` before query/traversal/index unless helper such as `withOpenGraphProvider` manages lifecycle. No auto-open/close. Backends MAY defer binding resolution, native load, worker startup, schema prep, generation checks until `open()`. Long-lived hosts (HTTP, MCP, Electron): sync create, `await open()`, reuse without sync SQLite blocking event loop, explicit close on shutdown/replacement.
- Runtime dependency `@specd/core` (`SpecdConfig`, `SpecdWorkspaceConfig`; may use `parseMetadata`, `SpecRepository`). Config derives composition inputs (`storagePath`, project root) only; provider does not cache config. Workspace targets and spec sources via `IndexOptions` each `index()`.
- Host use cases receive already-open provider: `GetGraphHealth`/`createGetGraphHealth` (statistics plus staleness and fingerprint diagnostics); `IndexProjectGraph`/`createIndexProjectGraph` (project index with optional force recreate); `GetSpecCoverage`/`createGetSpecCoverage`; `GetChangeSpecCoverage`/`createGetChangeSpecCoverage`. Search, hotspots, impact, traversal remain provider methods.
- Symbol-reference: single/batch resolution, canonical-symbol and public-binding impact, exact public-binding lookup by public surface, exported name, symbol space, canonical target identity; returns binding and declarations without ranked/paginated search. Unique/ambiguous/missing outcomes. Unqualified selectors: case-exact, then case-insensitive exact; never prefix/text widening; bounded candidates. Invalid host selectors (empty) use typed error code `INVALID_GRAPH_SELECTOR`, keep descriptive message. Candidate enrichment: exactly one exact batch lookup. Concrete resolver implementations and backend storage internal.
- Unified search: query, `symbols | files | specs | documents`, shared filters, per-category limit, snippet preference. Normalize exact file filter (workspace-relative, config/project-relative, or absolute) to one graph file; wildcards stay patterns. Shared use case: query plan, semantic-symbol and backend content lanes, locate precise occurrences, suppress only ranges covered by returned symbol selections, group/rank, cap general/wildcard occurrences per file, apply category limits after grouping and suppression. Exact single-file search returns every retained occurrence. Delivery adapters MUST NOT reimplement expansion, independent category merge, symbol/file dedup, or final limits. Lower-level search methods MAY remain; unified operation authoritative for cross-category behavior. Backend candidate types and helpers internal.

## Constraints

- Only construction path `createCodeGraphProvider`; `CodeGraphProvider` type-only; no exported constructor.
- Internals and store adapters only from `"./internal"`. `LanguageAdapter` exported from `"."`.
- Graph-store selection registry-driven inside composition; not a `specd.yaml` setting.
- Exactly one active `GraphStore` per construction; built-in registry and default id only `sqlite`.
- Facade holds no domain logic; owns lifecycle, availability, locks, destructive recovery.
- Explicit lifecycle; no auto-open/close or implicit recreation.
- Provider-owned indexing locks and destructive recreation helpers internal.
- Depends on `@specd/core` for `SpecdConfig`.
